description:
“I fear for what the world is going to look like when Trump, who has such a fragile ego, has to deal with this rebuke from the American electorate”.

Richard Goodstein, Democrat strategist and former advisor to Bill and Hillary Clinton, argues that there are only two types of elections for Donald Trump, "ones that he’s won or the others have been stolen”. 

Richard Goodstein and Thomas Del Beccaro, former chairman of the California Republican Party, were speaking to Ayesha Hazarika, on Times Radio Drive. Listen live every Sunday from 4pm–7pm.

Richard Williams was speaking to Rosie Wright and Guto Harri on Times Radio Breakfast. Listen live every Friday to Sunday, 6-10am.
